name: EISC pair: B
description: The other half of the EISC pair. It shows what A sends (toggle, level, text) on its panel and sends its own button and slider back to A.
panel: XPanel at IP ID 03; EISC at IP ID 10
tryIt: Watch digital 1, analog 1 and serial 1 follow A. Press digital 1 or move analog 1 here and see A's digital 2 and analog 2 follow.
